customRules: PINs must be 4-digit strings, generated with crypto.randomFillSync, compared as strings not numbers
Currency is COP — prices must be integers, never floats or decimals
IDs must be string format: `${timestamp}-${random}`
Backend uses CommonJS (require/module.exports). Do not use ESM import/export in backend/
Frontend uses ESM (import/export). Do not use require() in frontend/
Validate all request body fields before use — check for null/undefined/type
Wrap all async route handlers in try/catch with next(error)
Do not use res.status().send() or res.json() without return to stop execution
Validate payment methods against METODOS_PAGO constants before checkout
Validate room estado against ESTADO_CFG constants before state transitions
Check for race conditions in jsonStore.js file operations — use file locks
Auth middleware must verify JWT signature, expiration, and payload structure
PIN validation must track and limit failed attempts (max 3-5)
CheckIn must generate room PIN before saving room state
Checkout must calculate total from consumos + room price, not arbitrary input
Error responses must include 'error' key with descriptive message
Do not expose internal details (file paths, stack traces) in error responses
Validate dates are valid ISO strings before Date operations
Room number must be a positive integer string
Validate huesped field is non-empty string on check-in
